protocol.fit: Minimize diagonal weighted squared amplitude residuals over the declared grid; at each shape value fit nonnegative flux analytically using only training rows
protocol.uncertainty: Publisher RMS errors, diagonal approximation. Shared gain/calibration correlations, intrinsic variability and low-SNR non-Gaussian amplitude errors are not modeled. Criteria are project diagnostic thresholds, not a formal significance test.
protocol.holdoutPolicy: No refitting diameter, width, flux, error floor, selection or thresholds using 2013. Emit every selected holdout prediction and residual, including failures.
protocol.scientificScope: Visibility-model comparison for a simple stationary circular brightness surrogate. No GR radiative transfer, MHD, complex order-parameter, material-state, magnetic-field or observational black-hole-class validation. Emission-ring diameter is not identified with geometric shadow diameter.

fit.fluxPolicy: One compact flux shared across training years; unchanged on holdout
fit.intervalScope: Conditional diagonal-error grid profile only; not an accepted physical confidence interval when model/calibration assumptions fail.

limitations: Publisher RMS treated as independent Gaussian amplitude errors; gain correlations and low-SNR amplitude likelihood are omitted.
Stationary circular geometry and shared flux omit source variability, brightness asymmetry and extended emission.
Held-out failures remain reported; no 2013 refitting or post-hoc error floor is used.
These intensity amplitudes contain no order-parameter phase, vorticity, polarimetric or separate density/temperature/magnetic measurements.
Geometric emission ring is not identified with the Kerr geometric shadow. No GR radiative-transfer or MHD/phase-law validation follows.
